Description: Password-reset OTP is stored in plaintext
Steps to reproduce: Request a password reset in a controlled test environment and inspect the OTP record
Suggested fix: Hash reset OTPs before persistence and compare hashes during verification

Description: SMS OTP verification accepts any syntactically valid six-digit code
Steps to reproduce: Submit an incorrect six-digit code to the verification endpoint in a controlled test environment
Suggested fix: Restore server-side challenge comparison expiry and attempt limits or remove the unused endpoint

Description: Login page overflows horizontally at a 320px viewport
Steps to reproduce: Open login.html at a 320px viewport and compare document width with client width
Suggested fix: Adjust narrow-screen layout rules to eliminate horizontal overflow

Description: Activation does not require server-side proof that identity verification completed
Steps to reproduce: Call activation for a controlled masterlist record without completing the verification step
Suggested fix: Bind activation to a short-lived server-side verification token

Description: Activation attempts are not rate-limited
Steps to reproduce: Repeat activation attempts against a controlled test record
Suggested fix: Apply server-side rate limits and log excessive attempts

Description: Dashboard query failures appear as valid zero metrics
Steps to reproduce: Cause a summary query to fail in a controlled test database and inspect the dashboard response
Suggested fix: Return an explicit partial-data or error state instead of silently substituting zero values

Description: Youth events page requests profile data without the required youth role parameter
Steps to reproduce: Open the events page as a youth account and inspect the profile request
Suggested fix: Pass the youth role in the request and handle API failure visibly

Description: Event identifiers derived from row count can collide
Steps to reproduce: Create an event in a controlled database with sparse identifiers or retry concurrent submissions
Suggested fix: Use a database sequence or collision-safe unique identifier

Description: Admin event views interpolate user-controlled text into innerHTML without escaping
Steps to reproduce: Create an event with a benign controlled text marker and inspect admin event cards and details
Suggested fix: Render untrusted values with textContent or a consistent HTML-escaping helper

Description: Invalid event image replacement deletes the existing image before validating the new upload
Steps to reproduce: Attempt an invalid image replacement for a controlled test event and inspect the original image
Suggested fix: Validate and save the new upload first and remove the old file only after success

Description: Fractional quantities are silently truncated and borrower identity is trusted from request fields
Steps to reproduce: Submit a fractional quantity and an unknown member identity in a controlled test environment
Suggested fix: Reject non-integer quantities and derive borrower identity from the authenticated account or verified user record

Description: Standalone resources schema omits the quantity column required by borrow operations
Steps to reproduce: Create a test database with the standalone resources setup SQL and attempt a borrow/return
Suggested fix: Add the required column through setup SQL or a migration and verify fresh installs

Description: Upload validation is extension-based and copy limits are not enforced server-side
Steps to reproduce: Submit unsupported file content and copy counts outside the allowed range in a controlled test environment
Suggested fix: Validate file content and enforce server-side file-size and copies limits

Description: Deleting a print request leaves its uploaded document on disk
Steps to reproduce: Delete a controlled print request and check whether its stored document remains
Suggested fix: Remove the associated file after successful deletion using a validated storage path

Description: Admin UI omits supported print statuses and the manual-request form is unwired
Steps to reproduce: Inspect status filters and attempt to submit the manual-request form
Suggested fix: Implement the full status workflow and wire the form or remove the unused form

Description: Admin incident views interpolate user-submitted descriptions into innerHTML without escaping
Steps to reproduce: Submit a benign controlled text marker and inspect admin incident cards and details
Suggested fix: Render submitted text with textContent or a consistent escaping helper

Description: Incident uploads lack content validation and aggregate file count/size limits
Steps to reproduce: Submit controlled invalid-content and multiple-file cases in a test environment
Suggested fix: Validate file content and enforce aggregate file-count and total-size limits

Description: Incident schema setup runs from a youth page through admin-only routes and incompatible SQL
Steps to reproduce: Open the report page in a fresh controlled MySQL environment and inspect its setup requests
Suggested fix: Move schema changes into a compatible protected migration and remove page-load setup calls

Description: Separate admin Health Services page is unfinished and displays under-maintenance content
Steps to reproduce: Open dashboard-health.html as an admin
Suggested fix: Implement the service-management feature or remove and rename the unfinished route

Description: Admin UI claims draft support but provides no draft/publish control
Steps to reproduce: Create a disclosure through the admin form and inspect its resulting status
Suggested fix: Implement draft and publish controls or remove the unsupported workflow claim

Description: Public disclosure board and list API require a youth account
Steps to reproduce: Request the disclosure page and listing endpoint while logged out
Suggested fix: Confirm intended audience and allow public reads or clarify the youth-only policy

Description: Profile form submit handler is demo-only and does not persist edits
Steps to reproduce: Edit a controlled profile field submit and reload the profile page
Suggested fix: Wire the form to the authenticated update endpoint and show server validation errors

Description: Settings route has no implemented controls and is not reachable through shared system navigation
Steps to reproduce: Open dashboard-settings.html and inspect the System navigation group
Suggested fix: Implement settings or remove the unfinished route and navigation references

Description: Event-load and missing-print-request errors use native alerts instead of shared toast feedback
Steps to reproduce: Trigger those controlled error paths and compare feedback with the shared toast component
Suggested fix: Use the shared toast helper consistently for admin success and failure feedback

Description: Deployment installs PostgreSQL extensions while application configuration uses a MySQL DSN
Steps to reproduce: Build and run the deployment image and request a database-backed page
Suggested fix: Align installed database driver and DSN then run a clean deployment smoke test

Description: Setup endpoints can drop the events table and recreate an admin with a hard-coded password
Steps to reproduce: Review production route exposure without invoking the destructive scripts
Suggested fix: Remove these endpoints from production and use explicit protected migrations and secret provisioning
